h1: The Gun Hotel Premium — Rooms Bigger Than the Price, With a Balcony and Kitchenette in Central Surin
intro: The word Premium sounds upscale, but in truth The Gun Hotel Premium is a small city hotel whose selling point is the room itself — spacious, clean, with a comfy bed, and the part many guests love: every room has a private balcony and an in-room kitchenette with a fridge, microwave and kettle, ideal for longer stays or warming up your own food. It sits in the area around the Monument, within walking distance of the downtown market and City Pillar Shrine, with free parking · from approx. ฿800/night.

body.html: In Surin, where hotel options are limited, The Gun Hotel Premium is a small property that earns its praise mainly on the rooms. The point guests mention most is that the rooms are bigger than expected for the price — high ceilings, airy, simply decorated in light tones, not luxurious but clean and looking new. For a second-tier city like Surin, this standard of room at a sub-฿1,000 rate is hard to find.

What sets it apart from similarly priced hotels is that every room has a kitchenette and a balcony. Inside you'll find a fridge, microwave, kettle and a small prep corner, along with a work desk and a seating area. Guests who come to work, stay several nights, or travel with family say this part helps a lot — you can buy food at the market and warm it up in the room instead of hunting for a restaurant every meal.
"The bedroom is very comfortable, the mattress and pillow are clean, with a balcony and small kitchen, and the staff are very friendly."

The bed is another strong point — review after review agrees the mattress is soft, the pillows good and the linens clean, making for an easy night's sleep. The private bathroom has a water heater with decent pressure. The 24-hour front desk staff speak Thai, English and Khmer, and they come across as friendly and helpful, which is the impression most guests walk away with.

The location is in the around-the-Monument / downtown-market area on Suriyakarn Road. It is about a 9-minute walk to the Surin City Pillar Shrine and Wat Nongbua, while the central clock tower and downtown market are roughly 1.4 km away, a short drive. Several cafes and local restaurants are within walking distance, and there is free private on-site parking — handy if you arrive by car.

Limitations to know before booking: the building has no lift, so an upper-floor room means carrying your bags up the stairs — guests with heavy luggage or mobility issues should request a ground-floor room when booking. Some reviews note check-in takes longer than expected. And there is no breakfast and no swimming pool — this is a sleep-and-go hotel focused purely on the room, not a resort with full facilities.

The honest verdict: look past the slightly oversized Premium name and The Gun Hotel Premium is a sensible pick for anyone who wants a big, clean room with a kitchenette at a budget-friendly rate in central Surin — great for self-drivers, longer stays or work trips. But if you need breakfast, a pool or big-hotel service, this isn't the answer.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Gun Hotel Premium Surin

faq.q: Where is The Gun Hotel Premium in Surin, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 13/1 Suriyakarn Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Surin, in the around-the-Monument / downtown-market area · about a 9-minute walk to the Surin City Pillar Shrine and Wat Nongbua · the downtown market, clock tower and Surin Railway Station are roughly 1.4–1.5 km away.

faq.q: How much does The Gun Hotel Premium cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approx. ฿800/night for a Deluxe Double · there are also Twin and Super Deluxe King rooms · every room has a balcony and kitchenette (fridge, microwave, kettle) · prices vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does The Gun Hotel Premium have a lift and breakfast?
faq.a: There is no lift — an upper-floor room means stairs, so guests with heavy luggage should request a ground-floor room when booking · there is also no breakfast and no swimming pool, but several cafes and local restaurants are within walking distance.

faq.q: Who is The Gun Hotel Premium best for?
faq.a: It's great for self-drivers, multi-night stays or work trips who want a big, clean room with a kitchenette for warming food, at a budget-friendly rate · free parking is a plus · it's not the choice if you want full big-hotel service.

faq.q: Is there free parking and Wi-Fi?
faq.a: Yes to both · free private on-site parking and free Wi-Fi · the front desk is open 24 hours and staff speak Thai, English and Khmer.
